messages:
Eli Turner: Quick proposal: launch a tiny OSS starter-kit (plugin + refapp) with a short tutorial and a 25-min webinar that includes a live, reproducible benchmark. Goal = GH stars + dev signups + inbound leads.
Nora Alvarez: Love it. What are we calling it?
Eli Turner: Working name: 'StarterKit Ignite' 1: tutorial ('build a plugin in 10m'), a 2-file refapp, and a benchmark notebook.
Samira Khan: Timeline suggestion: announce Apr 18, publish tutorial Apr 25, open repo Apr 28, webinar May 2. Promo starts Apr 15.
Marcus Lee: For the benchmark narrative: show latency & cost for the plugin path vs direct API. Small sweep: seq=256, 40 requests. We'll show p50/p95 + cost per 1k tokens.
Priya Singh: I'll draft the tutorial (steps + minimal config). Keep it <800 words and runnable in <10 minutes. Need a short config snippet to paste.
Samira Khan: CTA: RSVP for webinar (capture email, role, company_size). Post-webinar CTA -> repo + 'try hosted' coupon. Also include hidden `intent` (eval/pilot).
Eli Turner: Add `deployment_interest` checkbox: Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Sales wants that for routing.
Nora Alvarez: Lead routing: DevRel Bot -> posts RSVPs to #marketing-leads and posts to HubSpot webhook. Mapping: email->email, company->company, utm_campaign->campaign. Is that current?
DevRel Bot: webhook probe: /integrations/hubspot/starterkit-ignite -> success.
Marcus Lee: Example bench command for the tutorial (small code block to paste):
```
# run mini-sweep
python bench.py --model plugin-enabled --seq 256 --requests 40 --warmup 5 --out summary.json
cat summary.json | jq '.summary | {p50,p95,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1k}'
```
Note: include `--warmup 5` for consistency.
Priya Singh: Perfect. I'll include that exact snippet. Also will add a tiny `config.yaml` example:
```
api_key: $REDWOOD_API_KEY
plugin: starterkit-ignite@v1
max_tokens: 200
```
Keep it tiny.
Samira Khan: Design needs: hero image (OSS), 8s GIF of plugin hot-reload demo, and a single slide with bench numbers. Can design deliver by Apr 23?
Nora Alvarez: We'll need assets by Apr 23 to lock landing. Promo cadence: Apr 15 announce, Apr 25 tutorial, Apr 28 repo open, May 2 webinar. Reminder emails 48h + 2h prior.
Marcus Lee: Backup plan for the live run: pre-record a bench video and have a lighter quantized model `plugin-small-quant` as fallback. Also cache a sample summary.json to show if live run fails.
Eli Turner: Agree. Also let's record the live bench run during dry-run so we have quick fallback.
Priya Singh: For the tutorial, I'll add a tiny 'how to interpret results' section explaining p50 vs p95 and batching. Keep it accessible.
Samira Khan: For tracking, add hidden field `region` (NA/EU/APAC) so we can route leads for demos. Also GDPR consent checkbox required.
Nora Alvarez: I'll wire the form. Sales asks: tag priority=pilot when `intent=pilot`. We'll map that in the webhook.
DevRel Bot: reminder set: dry-run May 1 09:00 PT -> invites sent to participants.
Marcus Lee: Ops note: reserve a small Dedicated slot for the demo window and pre-warm if possible. I'll request reservation.
Eli Turner: Messaging angles to test (A/B): 1) "Build an OSS plugin in 10 minutes" 2) "See the plug-in path: latency & cost, reproducible" 3) "StarterKit Ignite: plugin + refapp + benchmark". Priya, can you craft 3 headlines?
Priya Singh: Yep, I'll draft 3 variants and the short social copy.
Samira Khan: Repo naming: github.com/redwood-inference/starterkit-ignite-plugin (private until publish). We'll include bench.ipynb + demo server + README with sample results.
Nora Alvarez: Please include a results/benchmark_summary.json so people can inspect numbers without running infra. Good for quick PRs.
Marcus Lee: I'll prepare the bench script and a precomputed summary.json (realistic numbers) to seed results/.
Eli Turner: Review windows: tutorial draft Apr 20, bench script Apr 21, landing copy Apr 22, assets Apr 23. Who can review? Marcus for tech, Priya for copy, Samira for promo.
Marcus Lee: I'll review Apr 21.
Priya Singh: I'll review Apr 22.
Samira Khan: Promo review Apr 22.
Nora Alvarez: I'll create the marketing board card: "StarterKit Ignite: OSS plugin + replayable bench" and assign owners.
DevRel Bot: card created and assigned -> https://boards.redwood.ai/card/ignite-3501234567
Eli Turner: OK team. Quick thumbs if aligned. :thumbsup:
Eli Turner: :thumbsup:
